_source: Measured from the certified site project GP-BS-10472-291 (hamzici-hybrid-solar/GP BS HAMZIĆI_Čitluk K2 i AS 36 m, version A): 461 Graficki dio TEMELJ i OGRADA/01_Situacija 1_200.dwg and 04_Ograda.dwg, 463 Graficki dio OBJEKAT/01 Osnova.dwg and 04 Fasade.dwg, 462 .../01_Dispozicija S32 m.dwg, 5_ELEKTRO/3.6.9 Plan uzemljivača objekta.dwg, converted to DXF with ODA File Converter and read with ezdxf. Millimetres, in a slab-local PLAN frame: origin = the plan south-west corner of the 5 400 mm slab, +X = plan EAST, +Y = plan NORTH. Plan north is TRUE NORTH-WEST (bearing 315°, Google Maps, Investor 11.09.2026), so plan N / E / S / W = true SZ / SI / JI / JZ - see 'orientation'. Keys and comments that say NORTH / SOUTH / EAST / WEST mean the plan sides.
_verification: Container 2300 x 3005 external with 60 mm panels = 2180 x 2885 internal = 6,29 m2 and 10,13 m perimeter - both annotated on 01 Osnova.dwg ('P = 6.29 m2', 'O = 10.13 m'). Offsets container-to-slab 1550 / 1197,5 read off the situation drawing's own dimension entities (1550, 2300, 1550; 5400; 12000; 12500).

stulz.what: Stulz WDE80 kompaktni zidni klima-uređaj (Wall-Air), 8 kW
stulz.position: centred on the south wall (the 2300 mm face opposite the door) - Investor 11.09.2026; the earlier reading 'east wall, SE corner' is withdrawn
stulz.source: photos 08.09.2026 (20260908_121141(1).jpg and others) and the Investor (11.09.2026); size estimated from the photos - measure the unit and its wall cut-outs at intake
stulz.cutouts_note: The 2017 design (6_MASINSKE, 5,4 kW compact unit) specifies two 30/70 cm openings (supply low, return high) plus a 10/10 cable hole; the installed WDE80 is a larger unit, so the real cut-outs must be measured.

tower.note: Lattice tower 32 m (the project title says 'AS 36 m', a template leftover; 462 .../01_Dispozicija S32 m.dwg carries 32 000). Platform P I at +3,0 m doubles as an ice shield and sits over the container roof (+2,89 m) - no exhaust can terminate above the roof.

orientation.stulz: plan SOUTH wall = true JI (south-east), centred
orientation.pv_array: plan WEST band = true JZ (south-west): one row of 4 separate stands parallel to the lease line, facing true SW (azimuth 225°)
orientation.note: Google Maps (Investor 11.09.2026): the compound is turned 45° against true north - the door and gate face true north-WEST, the Stulz face true south-EAST. The drawings stay square to the compound and carry a north arrow turned 45°. The certified 2017 situation drawing shows door and gate on the opposite side, i.e. it is rotated by about 180° relative to the site. PV: not SE (tree, road to the NE); the true-SW band takes the row (Investor 11.09.2026). The bidder verifies the orientation during the mandatory site visit.

earthing.ring: postojeći uzemljivač Fe/Zn 25x4 mm: prsten u temeljima stopa stuba i prsten na dubini 0,8 m oko ploče (3.6.9 Plan uzemljivača objekta)
earthing.note: New PV supports and the container equipment bond to this ring.

obstacles.tree: listopadno stablo 7-9 m, 15-20 m JJI-JI od stuba, izvan zakupa (procjena iz fotografija 08.09.2026); ostaje - vidi review/09-odluka-nosaci-nagib.md
